item.title: Israel launches fresh strikes on Lebanon despite Trump criticism
item.description: Speaking on Tuesday, Trump said Israel's PM Benjamin Netanyahu needed "to be more responsible with respect to Lebanon".

item.title: Status quo at Jerusalem's holiest site under threat as Israeli nationalists flout rules
item.description: Israeli nationalists are increasingly flouting a convention on how faiths share the al-Aqsa mosque compound.

item.title: The bikers battling extreme heat and armed conflict to smuggle Iranian fuel to Pakistan
item.description: It's so hot the fuel can catch fire - the bikers tell the BBC they must live with the risk of injury and death.

item.title: Tehran selling deal with US as victory – but for Iranians it was necessity
item.description: For many Iranians, the question is not whether the deal means victory, but whether it lowers prices and reduces fear of another war.

item.title: Bowen: Plan for Hamas to disarm faces big obstacles, yet it offers rare hope for Gaza
item.description: The realities of politics, war, zero trust, the deaths of thousands and the destruction of Gaza will make any agreement very complicated.

item.title: Why limited war with the US may suit Iran better than peace
item.description: Iran may believe it can control its conflict carefully enough to keep pressure on the US while avoiding an all-out war.

item.title: UK investigating reports Russian warship fired warning shots near yacht in English Channel
item.description: The retired couple tell BBC Newsnight they tried to show the warship they had changed course in the English Channel before the shots were fired.

item.title: Three reasons ships are not going through the Strait of Hormuz yet
item.description: Experts say that there are significant obstacles preventing traffic from returning to the levels seen before the conflict began – security, mines and tolls.

item.title: At least five members of same family killed in Russian missile attack, Zelensky says
item.description: A six-year-old girl and two boys, aged 11 and 17, were among six killed in a village near the central city of Kryvyi Rih.

item.title: Missile that left crater deep inside Poland was probably Russian - Polish PM
item.description: The missile left a 10m-wide (33ft) crater a short distance from the village of Tarnawa Kolonia, about 100km from the border with Ukraine.
